notes.title: War of Kosovo: 2033 Beta 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40354857/da13e5d97bd278402b3917cd2d5cd2cd2fd88021.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40354857/6107250b289f2f26a1781021d0ab93249d6d0c80.png[/img][/url]
[h1]Beta 1.0.3 Patch Updates[/h1]

- [b]Presivy[/b] map has been redesigned and scaled to fit 5v5 perfectly

- Changes have been made to game mechanics 

- Fixed collision bugs on Presivy

- Added dynamic lightning

- [b]Prizren[/b] map have been listed for remaster 

- Lag issues have been fixed

- Fixed lightning bugs

- Added new weapon sounds

- Fixed shadows performance usage

- [b]Prizren[/b] map is now bigger to fit 32 players perfectly

- New widgets with animations

- [b]Competitive[/b] mode added to the game



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40354857/da13e5d97bd278402b3917cd2d5cd2cd2fd88021.png[/img]
